question: A 65-year-old woman with no personal history of interest, operated on for sigmoid adenocarcinoma that infiltrates the serosa (T4) with involvement of 2 lymph nodes of 35 isolates (N1). In the extension study, no distant metastasis (M0) is evident. What is the next step to make?

options.opa: Determine mutation of KRAS and NRAS to be able to administer an anti-EFGR in case of not being mutated.
options.opb: Associate treatment with chemotherapy bevacizumab if mutated.
options.opc: Administer a combination of chemotherapy with fluorouracil and oxaliplatin.
options.opd: Perform treatment with radiotherapy by having lymph node involvement.
